XCTS_legacy_50A_single_channel.interpretation: One illustrative legacy 50A-family range: 50mA precision (some ranges 100mA). This is NOT an attested calibration tolerance

CTS_legacy_two_channels.interpretation: Conservative 5A CTS-family upper current-range scenario of 1mA per channel, summed over two parallel source labels; actual unit/range accuracy must be independently verified

uniform_voltage_error_scenario.interpretation: Hypothetical ±1mV per measurement, across two voltages per ET and two per AT; not a CI or certificate and does not bound OCV model or current/thermal errors
